sprint: Story-Owned Freeform Text Popup — Weight Dropdown Retired, Bold/Underline/Strikethrough Added
task: 'remove the weights drop down . add bold , underline and strike through styles. Spin functionality of here should be in world own text objects context menu also.' Investigation confirmed World-owned Text's Rotation ('Spin') already existed from an earlier sprint this session -- no new code needed for that ask. Real work: _appendStickerTextEditControl (js/contextPanel.js) rewritten to remove the STICKER_TEXT_WEIGHT_OPTIONS dropdown (Font Family now spans its own row alone) and add a 4-button _makeMultiToggleRow Style row (Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough), mirroring World-owned Text's own already-proven pattern -- writes fontWeight/fontStyle plus two new plain boolean fields (underline/strikethrough) directly onto the sticker instance via the existing SceneEngine.updateSticker shallow merge, zero SceneEngine changes needed. renderer/slideRenderer.js's _drawFreeformText gained manually-stroked underline/strikethrough lines (canvas has no native text-decoration), ported from but separately maintained from World-owned text's _layerDrawText technique, honoring the sticker's own fixed textBaseline:'middle'. Verified via a new Playwright suite (bold_underline_strike_verify.js, 20/20 assertions) with real canvas pixel-sampling confirming the strokes genuinely paint, not just get stored in the model -- two real test-authoring bugs (a hardcoded-portrait canvas-scale assumption; an unscoped icon-card query matching Alignment buttons too) were found and fixed in the TEST itself, neither an app bug. Full regression across sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js (32/32), bold_toggle_verify.js (22/22, confirming World-owned Text's own separate Style row/Rotation are untouched), and welcome_heading_removed_verify.js (4/4) -- 85 total assertions, zero failures. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged -- confined entirely to root Studio. Disclosed, not fixed: js/cardDesigner.js's own sticker Text group (the full-editor surface shown on a text sticker's FIRST selection) still has the old Weight dropdown/Normal-Italic-only Style row, a real but out-of-scope inconsistency. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to js/contextPanel.js and renderer/slideRenderer.js.
